name: fireweave-sdk-node-workspace
description: Fireweave polyglot SDK — Node workspace (packages, tests, conformance)

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:compat
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run conformance && npm run smoke
